title: CS daily scratchpad - Emily Park - 2026-03-29
body:
Morning checklist (quick)
- 9:00 standup with CS team - give quick status on high-priority accounts
- 9:30 call: Acme Health QBR dry run with SE (Jordan) - align on metrics + deck flow
- 11:00 renewal outreach: BetaApps - send renewal scoping email + attach updated pricing options
- 14:00 support sync: CloudScale latency incident review with SRE and Eng (Samira)
- 16:00 admin: update Gainsight playbook entries and log notes

Today priorities
1) Acme Health QBR (next Tue) - high priority
   - Finish slide deck updates (cost vs. usage, latency P95, top 3 wins last quarter)
   - Confirm exec attendees (ask Kate > CFO, Mark > Head of Eng) - ask account exec to confirm by EOD Monday
   - Prep talking points: business impact of latency improvements, ROI from caching changes, next steps for pilot of Dedicated
   - Action: ask Jordan to include 90-day usage graphs and top 5 prompt patterns (due by EOD today)

2) BetaApps renewal (45 days) - mid priority
   - Current MRR: $18.4k, growth QoQ 7% but usage spike on sandbox causing cost concerns
   - Goal: move them from monthly to annual w/ 10% discount + optional Dedicated pilot trial
   - Tasks: draft email with 3 pricing scenarios (standard, committed, pilot) and ask for meeting next week
   - Linked artifacts: CSUP-412 (renewal pricing), confluence:pricing/pilot-proposal-draft

3) CloudScale support escalation - urgent until triaged
   - Problem: increased token latency for long-context generation (P99 up to 2.3s) since 3/24 deploy
   - Current status: Eng triage assigned (Samira) - SE working on reproducer, SRE has rollback flag ready
   - My owner tasks: coordinate customer comms (status email + ETA), gather recent request IDs for Eng, schedule 14:00 triage meeting
   - Slack: #cs-incident-cloudscale - keep updates concise and include customer impact summary

Other follow-ups / reminders
- Revisit QBR agenda template: add a short "cost posture" slide (suggested by finance) - update confluence QBR template
- Ask Solutions Eng to prepare 2 slide examples showing expected latency improvement after quantization/kv-cache (for Acme Health QBR)
- Check with Legal on BetaApps data residency clause for Dedicated pilot (possible blocker) - legal@redwood
- Update renewal tracker spreadsheet row for BetaApps (link in confluence)

Notes to self / questions
- Do we have pre-built graphs for 90/30/7 day active prompts? If not, ask analytics to run a quick query (cc: analytics@redwood)
- For QBR, focus no more than 5 slides on tech; execs want outcomes and $$ impact
- If Acme requests a Dedicated trial, confirm capacity (contact infra on-call) and estimate cost delta

Quick copy snippets to reuse
- Renewal outreach subject: "Redwood renewal & pilot options — BetaApps"
- Support status blurb: "We’re actively investigating increased latency for long-context requests. Engineering is triaging; ETA for root cause within 24 hours. Will update at [time]."
- QBR invite wording (execs): "Quick session to review usage, cost, reliability improvements, and recommended next steps for scale."

Time-blocking (rough)
- 08:30-09:00 - triage emails + prep standup notes
- 09:00-09:30 - team standup
- 09:30-10:45 - Acme dry run + deck edits w/ Jordan
- 11:00-12:00 - draft BetaApps renewal email + attach pricing scenarios
- 13:00-14:00 - lunch + quick catch-up with Samira offline
- 14:00-15:00 - CloudScale triage meeting (SRE/Eng/SE)
- 15:00-16:00 - update confluence, Gainsight, and renewal tracker
- 16:00-17:00 - follow-ups, buffer, and next-day plan

Meeting prep bullets (Acme QBR)
- Opening: 1 slide agenda + 1 slide where we list improvements since last QBR
- Usage: 90/30/7 day active users, top prompt categories, cost per 1k tokens pre/post caching
- Performance: P50/P95/P99 latency (before/after infra changes), error rates, availability SLA adherence
- Business: revenue tied to product feature X (example), adoption metrics, conversion funnel impact
- Ask: approval to run a 6-week Dedicated pilot (estimate cost delta + expected 30% latency improvement)

Logging / tickets to update after calls
- Update CSUP-398 with Acme QBR notes + attachments
- Create CSUP-421 (BetaApps renewal outreach) if not present
- Add CloudScale incident logs to support ticket CSUP-407 and include reproducible requests

Random scratch items (brain dump)
- Consider a short "what to expect" sheet for exec QBRs (1 pager) - reusable across accounts
- Can we template the renewal scenarios for 10/20/30% discounts to scale outreach? (ask Rev Ops)

End of day must-haves
- Acme deck updated + Jordan confirms graphs included
- BetaApps renewal email drafted and scheduled for Monday
- CloudScale customer update sent with clear ETA and next steps

-- emily
(leave notes here as I go; will tidy up into confluence after 17:00)
